inferential_role: environmental-condition association; not the human-access or land-conversion causal track
geography: Kalimantan baseline-natural-forest cells in the frozen MapBiomas Indonesia Collection 4.1 2014 grid

outcome.missing_daily_product_rule: if the VNP14A1 event-day image is absent, record the calendar day as having no observation opportunity; never code it as a negative or zero fire day. If only a required lookback image is absent, use the registered science-quality MODIS history fallback and retain the VNP14A1 event-day outcome.

history_gap_fallback.reason: VNP14A1 source-archive gaps were confirmed before any Phase 2 model was fitted; the fallback prevents a missing lookback image from discarding an otherwise observed VNP14A1 event day.
history_gap_fallback.fusion_rule: fire if either donor FireMask is class 7-9; valid non-fire land if neither donor reports fire and either donor is class 5; otherwise unprocessed
history_gap_fallback.event_outcome_prohibition: fallback products must never define the primary event-day outcome
history_gap_fallback.sensitivity_requirement: report results with all history-fallback dates excluded

era5_land.native_resolution_caveat: approximately 9 km; sampled to cells without claiming 1-km climate measurement
era5_land.coastal_no_data_rule: use the nearest fully valid ERA5-Land cell within 25 km; otherwise exclude the whole matched set and report it

release_rules.do_not_fit_until: complete frame, covariate, provenance, registration, and immutable-input-lock gates all pass
release_rules.human_access_claim: blocked pending a dated access exposure; this track cannot answer government intent, arson motive, plantation profit, or road-opening causality
